description: ¡Hola! Somos un equipo de estudiantes apasionadas por la ciencia, la programación y la tecnología. Nos encanta resolver problemas utilizando herramientas como Scratch, bloques de código y automatización, además de explorar temas de física, ciencias espaciales e investigación. Buscamos que más personas se unan a nuestra iniciativa para aportar nuevas ideas, creatividad y diferentes perspectivas para enfrentar los retos del Space Apps Challenge.
summary: Iris's Lunar Adventure is an interactive, child-friendly web game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Guided by Iris, an adorable astronaut cat, players embark on an educational journey to plan a lunar mission and search for water ice at the Moon's South Pole. The game addresses the challenge of mission design by teaching children how to manage limited budgets, rocket payloads, scientific instruments, and energy requirements. Players choose space meals (such as BBQ ribs, grilled chicken, or sweet crepes), select reliable rockets, and target the shadowed Shackleton Crater. By utilizing real NASA LRO open data, the game demonstrates how lasers confirm underground water deposits. It is important because it inspires the next generation of space explorers through interactive STEM education and gamified science.
details:
What it does & how it works:

Iris's Lunar Adventure is an intuitive, 5-phase interactive web application. Guided by Iris (our white and orange astronaut cat), players take control of mission design by making critical engineering choices: selecting space food, choosing a heavy-lift rocket, targeting a lunar destination, and powering scientific instruments.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

The project simplifies complex aerospace engineering concepts for children and students. It teaches resource management (budget and weight limits) and highlights the importance of the lunar South Pole for future sustainable space exploration (like the Artemis program).

Tools, Languages, & Technologies:

- Frontend: Pure HTML5, advanced CSS3 (with custom gradients and responsive grids), and vanilla JavaScript.

- Assets: High-resolution open-source imagery and interactive card layouts.

- Audio: Integrated ambient background audio with player controls.

Creativity & Design Considerations:

We focused on delivering an engaging, colorful narrative driven by an animal companion (Iris) to make space science approachable. The interface features automatic scroll navigation to keep the user focused on instructions, instant budget/weight calculation feedback, and a rewarding visual landing scene upon successfully detecting lunar water.
